build.name: cpucp
build.build_command: make CHIPSET=kailua target_sign_v2_qti_test && make CHIPSET=camano target_sign_v2_qti_test && rm -rf .git*

build.name: cpuss_vm
build.build_command: export PATH=/pkg/qct/software/gnu/make/4.1/bin:$PATH && make SOC_FAMILY=kailua release && make SOC_FAMILY=camano release && rm -rf .git* README.md

build.name: wlan_pine
build.build_command: export CRM_BUILDID=${CRM_BUILDID}; export PATH=$PATH:/pkg/qct/software/ubuntu/mksquashfs/; cd ./wlan_proc/build/ms; sh build_v1_v2_Maple_Pine.sh; cd ../../../; /pkg/qct/qctss/linux/ubuntu/16.04/python279/bin/python wlan_proc/wlan/mac_core/syssw/src/platform/debug/scripts/memory_analysis/memory_report_pine.py --output ./static_mem_data_pine; pwd; mkdir -p ./BIN-WLAN-HWV2; mkdir -p ./SRC-WLAN-HKV2;

step.params: python @tool_name sectools metabuild-secure-image --vouch-for --image-id QUPV3 AOP SHRM XBL-CONFIG UEFI XBL-RAM-DUMP CPUCP TZ QHEE TZ-DEVCFG MPSS ADSP CDSP MCP-OEM CPUSYS-VM --outfile @out_file --chipset KAILUA --hash --signing-mode TEST --sign --flavor asic -vv
